Subject: Discovery recap & next steps — schedule demo / security deep-dive - FinPath

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from my side: 
- Primary use case: customer support summarization + routing, with embeddings for semantic search across support logs.
- Key constraints: PII redaction, < 150ms p95 latency target for short responses, and strict data retention controls.
- Success metric: 30% reduction in avg handle time and reliable intent classification for top 5 intents.

Next steps I propose:
1) 60-min demo + technical deep-dive (runtime, quantization options, VPC Private deployment options) — recommended participants: engineering platform lead + security/compliance.
2) Share Mutual Action Plan and SOC2 summary for initial procurement/security review (attached).
3) Align on procurement timeline and any PO/contract requirements.

Are you available for a demo next week? I can do:
- Tue 6 Oct: 2:00–3:00pm PT
- Thu 8 Oct: 10:00–11:00am PT
- Fri 9 Oct: 9:00–10:00am PT

Looping in Rishi (AE) to help coordinate procurement and Stephanie (CS) for onboarding context; I will also pull in our security lead once we confirm a slot.

Attachments: Mutual Action Plan - FinPath.pdf

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
